title: 0.5초의 물리학
sp: Cinematic orchestral score. upright bass walking line. upright bass walking line. The beat is built around a jazzy, sampled piano loop playing minor seventh chords and a syncopated boom-bap drum pattern. Male tenor vocals are centered in the mix with subtle doubling during the chorus. full band, open power chords. The arrangement features a solo oboe and flute playing a playful, staccato melody in 3/4 time.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[oboe melody over piano ostinato]
[filtered acoustic piano enters with a four-bar loop]

[Verse 1]
리모컨 건네는 아버지 손에
기미가 늘었다
모른 척 TV를 봤다

[Chorus]
Layered leads, maximum energy

[Interlude]
[staccato strings, piano arpeggios]
[piano filter closes further, reducing high-end clarity]

[Verse 2]
사직서 냈다 드디어
하늘이 다르게 보여
짐 싼 박스 하나 들고
회사 앞을 걸어 나와

[Chorus]
카페는 다시 조용해졌는데
심장만 시끄러웠다
0.5초의 물리학
질량은 없는데 무게가 있다

[Bridge]
겁먹지 마 괜찮더라
새 출발이란 게 이런 거더라

[Outro]
[strings fade to pianissimo, final piano chord]
[piano loop fades out with increasing reverb]
song_form_type: intro → verse → chorus → interlude → verse → chorus → bridge → outro

title: 하루
sp: K-Rock with high-gain electric guitars and driving percussion. The arrangement centers on a solo violin playing a lyrical melody over a grand piano. The arrangement centers on a solo violin playing a lyrical melody over a grand piano. K-Pop rock anthem featuring distorted electric guitars, driving acoustic drums, and a slap bass technique. K-Pop ballad featuring a baritone male vocal with heavy plate reverb. The arrangement is sparse and intimate. Key of E Major, 105 BPM, 4/4 time signature.
lyrics:

하지만 분수는

[Chorus]

떨어지다 멈추는 그 일 초가
오늘 하루 중 가장 살아있는 순간

[full band enters, distorted electric guitar, driving drums]
[distorted guitar, driving drums, bass guitar]

title: 전부
sp: K-Pop and Future Bass fusion. final brass stab, bass slide down. final brass stab, bass slide down. sp: K-Pop ballad. K-Pop Hip-Hop track featuring a prominent funk-influenced electric bassline playing syncopated sixteenth-note patterns. vocal intensity increases, strings swell. A cinematic percussion ensemble includes taiko drums, orchestral snares, and metallic hits. vocal humming. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing sustained chords and melodic fills. Key of G Major.
